verdict.rationale: Resend exposes the raw signals: real-time email event webhooks, delivery-event monitoring, an account activity view, broadcast link-click retrieval, and a suppression list. It also says it will warm up and monitor dedicated IPs. There is no evidence of bounce or complaint analytics dashboards, or of guidance on inbox placement or sender reputation. Missing for 10: bounce/complaint rate analytics, engagement analytics beyond link clicks, inbox placement insights, sender reputation guidance or scoring, independent corroboration.
